headlines.title: Supreme Court temporarily allows Trump ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: Supreme Court rules on whether Trump can move forward with construction on the White House ballroom.

headlines.title: Plane crash near remote radar site in Alaska kills 8 people
headlines.description: A plane crash in a remote region of Alaska has left eight people dead, including two U.S. Army Corps of Engineers employees. The crash happened at Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport, some 450 miles west of Anchorage.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Vance’s homecoming is a throwback to 2024 — and a preview for 2026 and 2028: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance’s return to his hometown was in many ways a preview of the heavy load he will carry for President Donald Trump and the Republican Party on the midterm campaign trail.

headlines.title: Trump says loyalist Ed Martin to leave the DOJ to focus on election-related legal battles
headlines.description: Trump loyalist Ed Martin, a “Stop the Steal” organizer and advocate and attorney for Jan. 6 defendants, who later served in the Justice Department, is leaving the administration to focus on upcoming elections.

headlines.title: 11 arrested after federal agents board cruise ships in Boston
headlines.description: Federal authorities arrested 11 people after boarding two cruise ships in Boston, accusing them of receiving and distributing child sexual abuse material and child sexual exploitation material.

headlines.title: Former Abercrombie & Fitch CEO Michael Jeffries competent to face sex trafficking trial, judge rules
headlines.description: Michael Jeffries, the former CEO of Abercrombie & Fitch who was charged with running an international sex trafficking scheme over several years while he ran the company, is mentally competent for trial, a federal judge ruled.

headlines.title: Supreme Court temporarily allows Trump ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: Supreme Court rules on whether Trump can move forward with construction on the White House ballroom.

headlines.title: Eye drops recalled over possible contamination, FDA reports
headlines.description: The FDA reported that bottles of Clear Eyes Maximum Itchy Eye Relief have been recalled over potential contamination.

headlines.title: Laken Snelling, whose infant was found dead in closet, pleads guilty to manslaughter
headlines.description: Former University of Kentucky student-athlete Laken Snelling pleaded guilty to first-degree manslaughter in the death of her infant son, whose body was found inside a trash bag in a closet.

headlines.title: Teen says ‘demons’ made him stab girlfriend, then his mom helped hide her body, police say
headlines.description: A Pennsylvania teenager told police “demons” prompted him to fatally stab his girlfriend, a college soccer player, before his mother helped him clean up the crime scene and move the victim’s body, authorities said Thursday.

headlines.title: This is what you need (and need to do) to stay safe this hurricane season
headlines.description: I talked to a meteorologist to find the best way to prepare for hurricanes and what products you should have on hand.
